== Description ==
The Players Committee's full card image and printable release-sheet slip of [[Boba Fett With Blaster Rifle (V)]]. Both display identical game text.

[[:File:V22-D-bobafettwithblasterrifle.gif|Players Committee full card image]] and [[:File:V22-D-bobafettwithblasterrifle-2023-10-06-sheet-slip.png|October 2023 slip]] from page 1 of the [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-22.pdf Virtual Set 22 release sheet]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261114020627id_/https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-22.pdf Internet Archive].

== Changes ==
The full card image was scaled to the slip height and placed beside the slip for comparison.
